answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 46086 Country: India Title: Magic Question: Can we believe in black magic and magic? And will it effect anything to us? Kindly response. Answer ID: 46086 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 968/968/M=1434) Magic is a reality and it has effect. السحر حق عندنا وجوده وتصوره وأثره (شامى) Hence there is no harm if someone believes in its existence and effects. However, until it is not known about magic with Shariah research that who did it, it cannot be said that so and so person has done magic. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
